notes: Page 1 shows the cover panel plus building steps 1-5; the parts list was applied.
Step 1: Wedge Plate 3x6 with two dark blue 2x2 grooved tiles (b2, b3). Step 2: a light bluish gray 1x3 tile (b4) between them. I could not tell exactly which studs they use.
Step 3: model is flipped and a black clip plate (b5) is added. Which piece it rests on is a guess; the booklet pictures it over a blue area.
Step 4: two light bluish gray 2x2 round plates (b6, b7).

Step 5: the sidebar sub-assemblies are tiny and low-resolution. The sidebar steps are: 1 = round plate b8; 2 = blue 1x2 plate b9 + light gray side-handle plate b10; 3 = blue 1x2 plate b11 + two trans-light-blue 1x1 round plates b12, b13. Their exact attachment to the hull is uncertain, so rests_on [b1] is an assumption, and b10 resting on b9 is also assumed.
Curved bricks, the other plates and the remaining parts are presumably used on later pages.

Sidebar (steps 1-2): the slope b15 goes on the handle plate b14, then the blue curved brick b16 on top. The arm b17 hangs off the handle. The sub-assembly is attached to the hull in step 6 (flip the model, swing the cockpit over).

Wings (steps 1-5, boxed 2x): both copies are listed, b18-b27 and b28-b37. Per wing: clip plate 60470a, handle plate 48336, two 1x4 blue plates, four curved bricks (two layers of two) and two grille tiles. The booklet is small, so the stacking of the curved bricks and tiles is my best reading.

Step 7 attaches both wings to the hull sides. The exact attachment points are not clear, so those joins are guesses; the arm's second clip to b5 is also uncertain, since two clips would not normally join.

Not placed because I could not find where they go: 3x lego-3023 (Dark Blue), 1x lego-63864 (Tile 1x3) and 1x lego-63868 (Black clip plate). They may be hidden in the step 6-7 views or have been assigned differently on page 1, so I did not invent placements.

This adds the five pieces the inventory check found missing: 3x lego-3023 (b40-b42), 1x lego-63864 (b38) and 1x lego-63868 (b39). The parts list says the set uses them, so they are real, but the small booklet drawings do not show clearly where each goes.

Placement is an assumption. I put all five on the hull wedge b1 (rests_on [b1]), in the area around the cockpit and the side clip points shown in steps 6-7: the gray 1x3 tile b38 beside the cockpit, the second black clip plate b39 on the opposite side from b5, and the three blue 1x2 plates b40-b42 around the cockpit and wing roots.
Everything already given stays as it was. This response only adds pieces.
